market.detail: The owner retained 15,450,173 normalized rows: 6,290,001 newly normalized and 9,160,172 reused. The selected 22,939 historical requests comprise 13,378 conversions and 9,561 quarantines. This is not proof of complete current-season collection.

model_cohorts.description: Newly graded earlier issued refits: 29 identical games, 26 model/target scorecards. Three identity-changed games (78 rows) are quarantined. One week of outcomes. LightGBM accuracy is 23/29 with a descriptive conditional 95% Wilson interval of 61.6–90.2%; its paired log-loss advantage over logistic regression also spans zero. Team/week dependence and selection are not validated. No promotion.
